cohort: 1402 mother-child pairs (1043 term, 359 preterm) recruited at birth from 1998-2013 from a U.S. urban low-income birth cohort.
finding: Maternal prepregnancy overweight or obesity (OWO) was significantly associated with childhood OWO, and maternal C4-OH levels explained about 27% of this inter-generational OWO risk in term births, but not in preterm births.
gest_age: Categorized as term or preterm births
